values.label: Business Purpose
values.description: Collected/used for the requested business interaction such as a form submission or lead workflow; distinct from optional analytics consent.

values.description: Subject to marketing/advertising consent rules where configured/applicable.

values.description: Required for a requested functional service rather than optional analytics/marketing.
